actual: Observed production task official_factor_full_1783850439565_76472 requested 585 official factors for 2018-08-01..2026-06-30 and completed 109 factors (545 metric rows) before batch 7 triggered memory_gate_failed: available_memory_below_minimum. The current worker controller terminates active factor processes and marks all remaining 476 factors failed, without preserving the resource snapshot in the persisted runtime result, retrying at lower concurrency, or exposing a resumable failed-factor submission. A partial run also advances top-level cache metadata to the target snapshot while per-factor cache dates remain mixed, and the in-memory active-task counter remains stale after failure. Fix the official pipeline so it retains strict data/metric semantics: checkpoints are explicit, only a fully complete consistent snapshot is promoted, failed factors can be submitted exactly without recomputing completed ones, memory pressure uses observable adaptive concurrency and bounded retry/recovery instead of silent fallback, and any terminal failure remains explicit with full resource evidence. Do not cancel, rewrite, or mutate the already failed task; do not weaken correlation cache readiness gates.
